an4.257:1.1: atha kho āyasmā māluṅkyaputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā māluṅkyaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an4.257:2.1: sādhu kho me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
an4.257:2.3: yatra hi nāma tvaṃ jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako tathāgatassa saṅkhittena ovādaṃ yācasīti.
an4.257:2.4: ”desetu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ, desetu sugato saṅkhittena dhammaṃ, appevanāmāhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājāneyyaṃ appevanāmāhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa dāyādo assanti.”
an4.257:3.1: cattārome māluṅkyaputta taṇhuppādā yattha bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati.
an4.257:3.3: cīvarahetu vā māluṅkyaputta bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati,
an4.257:3.4: piṇḍapātahetu vā māluṅkyaputta bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati,
an4.257:3.5: senāsanahetu vā māluṅkyaputta bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati,
an4.257:3.6: iti bhavābhavahetu vā māluṅkyaputta bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati.
an4.257:3.7: ime kho māluṅkyaputta cattāro taṇhuppādā yattha bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati.
an4.257:3.8: yato kho māluṅkyaputta bhikkhuno taṇhā pahīṇā hoti, ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. ayaṃ vuccati māluṅkyaputta bhikkhu acchecchi taṇhaṃ, vāvattayi saṃyojanaṃ, sammāmānābhisamayā antamakāsi dukkhassāti.
an4.257:4.1: atha kho āyasmā māluṅkyaputto bhagavatā iminā ovādena ovadito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an4.257:4.2: atha kho āyasmā māluṅkyaputto eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
an4.257:4.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
an4.257:4.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā māluṅkyaputto arahataṃ ahosīti.
